m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Security has been lax in Tyrian Gorge, of late. Burrowers and their friends mucking about.
Ghost Dog said to slay all who trespass here - get ready to face the heat!
You may have hit me between the eyes, but the Death's Head Sorcerer, Actias NightOrb, will stop you!
A Death's Head Sorcerer? They often carry Lunar Crystals. You could use them to create the illusion we need.
Who let you up here? Those Bane Tails let me down, didn't they? I'm just going to have to rock you like a hurricane!
Yargh! I thought only the Shadow Queen was privy to Shadow magic! What do you want my Lunar Crystals for, anyway?
From here you can see the stronghold of Fort Rachias. Use the Lunar Crystals to project your shadow as a challenge.
Then hurry down to meet me outside the Melanos Tower.
<ITALICS>You tap into the power of the Lunar Crystals. They emit a soft glow that gets stronger and brighter. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You summon up the Shadow self that Sofia DarkSide taught you, and project it through the Lunar Crystals. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>It rises up as a challenge to those in Fort Rachias. And even from here you think you can hear an answering roar! </ITALICS>
We need to drive out the Umbra Legion's forces from the Melanos Tower.
Let us drive out the Shadows from this ruin!
